name: blockrun-media
description: BlockRun media tools (image/video/audio) with spend-confirmation and a running cost meter, ported for OpenAI Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Pay-per-call image/video/audio with a spend gate + cost meter
interface.longDescription: Wraps the BlockRun MCP (media profile) with a PreToolUse spend gate (estimate + confirm), a PostToolUse tally that reads the real x402 settlement ledger, and cost-insight skills. No API keys — pays per call in USDC from a local wallet.
